statisticalOperationalization.axisCentering: unweighted mean of frozen log2 levels
statisticalOperationalization.primaryEstimator: random-intercept REML mixed-effects model paired by superblock
statisticalOperationalization.nonconvergenceFallback: same fixed-effect OLS formula with superblock-cluster-robust CR1 covariance and t(1295) inference
statisticalOperationalization.confirmatoryPValueAdjustment: Holm strong FWER at alpha 0.05 over all 35 composite hypotheses
statisticalOperationalization.D1IntersectionUnionPValue: maximum of geometric-mean and nearest-rank-P95 one-sided p-values
statisticalOperationalization.simultaneousIntervals: two-sided Bonferroni intervals at familywise alpha 0.05 over 40 primitive contrasts
statisticalOperationalization.domainPass: valid hard gates plus all four Holm-adjusted target-versus-domain-gate-comparator hypotheses and simultaneous intervals favorable
statisticalOperationalization.cFFReporting: retain formal comparison and provide concrete data and explanation whenever not passed
statisticalOperationalization.primaryClaim: at least four of seven domains pass; invalid domains remain in denominator
statisticalOperationalization.mipeRole: reporting flag only; statistical null remains ratio 1 or slope difference 0
statisticalOperationalization.exploratoryPairs: 15 unordered pairs in fixed cohort order, separate Holm family per domain
